## Liveness fact (required)

State one verifiable liveness fact for this entry: its latest release or
commit date, its current version, or the institution that maintains it.
Pull requests without a liveness fact are closed.

## Format check

- [ ] Entry follows the locked format: `- [Name](url) - one sentence of 8 to 15 words saying what it does, plus one decision fact (maintainer, licence, version, or star count)`
- [ ] The link is the canonical source and loads
- [ ] It is not a duplicate of an existing entry
- [ ] Security tooling is framed for authorised use
